# Lootura
> Lootura — What's happening. Discover the entities in the news, follow their coverage, and read the latest headlines from original publishers.

Lootura connects news coverage with the people, organizations, companies, places and products mentioned in it. It has two editions: Spain (Spanish) and the United States (English). Entity pages, their history and publisher references are hosted on lootura.com.

How to read this site:
- The cover is selected by deterministic rules and publisher evidence. The upper cover contains only entities with at least three distinct publisher domains covering the same event. The lower Front page requires three publications and Headlines requires two. If recent coverage is insufficient, the cover uses documented history labelled “Del archivo” / “From the archive”, with its original dates.
- Publication dates belong to the cited content. Export/review times and countdowns are operational information, not evidence that a story is new. Saved packages may become stale; check article dates and follow the original sources.
- Coverage counts reflect the publishers in the stored evidence, not every publisher on the internet. Special coverage decorates an already selected entity and requires at least eleven qualifying publisher domains.
- An entity profile is a reference page with a timeline, not an original news article written by Lootura. Attribute reporting and bylines to the linked publishers and authors. Cross-publisher corroboration does not establish that a factual claim is true.
- Stable canonical paths may retain an earlier category after a classification correction. Use the displayed name and type. The Spain and US catalogs contain different entities and are not translations of every profile.

## Site navigation
- [Home](https://lootura.com/)
- [XML sitemap](https://lootura.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical, indexable HTML pages only.
- [Robots policy](https://lootura.com/robots.txt)
- [Full entity reference](https://lootura.com/llms-full.txt): Admitted entity index, context, dates and source references for both editions.
